dc:title: Trustpilot review reporting statistics: a 2025 notice-table audit
dc:description: EU businesses reviewed by EU users; EU businesses reviewed by non-EU users; non-EU businesses reviewed by EU users. This is an EU-related subset, not a Canadian business sample.

columns.name: source_record
columns.dc:description: Logical record number in the source CSV; the header is record 1. Not a physical line number.

columns.name: row_type
columns.dc:description: total, category or subcategory. Parent and subcategory rows must not be added together.

columns.name: category_code
columns.dc:description: Original source taxonomy code; KEYWORD_OTHER repeats under different parent categories.

columns.name: parent_category
columns.dc:description: Original parent-category code for a subcategory; null for totals and parent rows.

columns.name: subcategory_description
columns.dc:description: Original source label, including any source spelling errors; blank labels remain null.

columns.name: reporting_period_original
columns.dc:description: Original source period string, including the preserved invalid 2025-12-32 end date in one row.

columns.name: notices
columns.dc:description: Reported count of notices received; not a count of confirmed fake reviews.

columns.name: trusted_notices
columns.dc:description: Reported trusted-flagger notice count, kept separate from the ordinary fields.

columns.name: items
columns.dc:description: Reported count of specific items of information; parent/subcategory totals do not all reconcile.

columns.name: trusted_items
columns.dc:description: Reported trusted-flagger item count; source total differs from the category field.

columns.name: median_hours
columns.dc:description: Reported median time to take action, in hours; not an arithmetic mean or a deadline.

columns.name: trusted_median_hours
columns.dc:description: Reported median action time for trusted-flagger notices, in hours.

columns.name: law_actions
columns.dc:description: Reported count of actions taken on the basis of law.

columns.name: trusted_law_actions
columns.dc:description: Reported law-basis action count for trusted-flagger notices.

columns.name: terms_actions
columns.dc:description: Reported terms-based action count; not matched notice-level removal outcomes.

columns.name: trusted_terms_actions
columns.dc:description: Reported terms-based action count for trusted-flagger notices; source total differs from category field.
